name: Florida Keys, FL
blurb: 82,874 residents on a 180 km chain of islands. One road out — US-1.
notes: Population: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 Decennial Census, Monroe County, Florida (the mainland part of the county — the Everglades — is essentially uninhabited, so the figure refers to the chain); roadlength mode (§4 step 8). Carless: no census data, zeros recorded (§4 step 9). Exits listed by name (§4 step 7): US 1, Overseas Highway, Card Sound Road. Tarjan (§3.3.8) dropped 163 vertices and 16.2 km of residential streets not connected to the city. OSM buildings attached to demand nodes: 25514; dropped beyond 300 m: 1621.
